if(NOT GVM_BUILD_SAMPLES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "GVM_BUILD_THREE_SAMPLES requires GVM_BUILD_SAMPLES=ON.")
endif()
if(NOT GVM_BUILD_SAMPLE_DESKTOP_BINARIES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "GVM_BUILD_THREE_SAMPLES currently requires GVM_BUILD_SAMPLE_DESKTOP_BINARIES=ON "
        "because Phase 1 validates windowed Metal and Vulkan hosts.")
endif()
if(GVM_BUILD_UGLC AND NOT UGLC_ENABLE_LEGACY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "GVM_BUILD_THREE_SAMPLES requires UGLC_ENABLE_LEGACY=ON for the in-tree compiler so every DSL "
        "shard is generated by both UGLC pipelines.")
endif()
if(NOT GVM_RHI_ENABLE_VULKAN)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "GVM_BUILD_THREE_SAMPLES requires GVM_RHI_ENABLE_VULKAN=ON for the Phase 1 backend matrix.")
endif()

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME nlohmann_json
    URL https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/download/v3.12.0/json.tar.xz
    URL_HASH SHA256=42f6e95cad6ec532fd372391373363b62a14af6d771056dbfc86160e6dfff7aa
    OPTIONS
        "JSON_BuildTests OFF"
        "JSON_Install OFF")

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME draco
    URL https://github.com/google/draco/archive/refs/tags/1.5.7.tar.gz
    URL_HASH SHA256=bf6b105b79223eab2b86795363dfe5e5356050006a96521477973aba8f036fe1
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL YES
    OPTIONS
        "DRACO_BUILD_TESTS OFF"
        "DRACO_BUILD_TOOLS OFF"
        "DRACO_JS_GLUE OFF"
        "DRACO_UNITY_PLUGIN OFF")

CPMAddPackage(
    NAME pugixml
    URL https://github.com/zeux/pugixml/releases/download/v1.15/pugixml-1.15.tar.gz
    URL_HASH SHA256=655ade57fa703fb421c2eb9a0113b5064bddb145d415dd1f88c79353d90d511a
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL YES
    OPTIONS
        "PUGIXML_BUILD_TESTS OFF"
        "PUGIXML_INSTALL OFF")

set(GVM_THREE_SAMPLE_SOURCE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

add_library(GVMThreeCompat STATIC
    ThreeCompat/Math.cpp
    ThreeCompat/Object3D.cpp
        ThreeCompat/Camera.cpp
        ThreeCompat/CurveExtras.cpp
    ThreeCompat/DeterministicRandom.cpp
    ThreeCompat/InstanceSampleGeometry.cpp
    ThreeCompat/EdgeSplitGeometry.cpp
    ThreeCompat/Nurbs.cpp
        ThreeCompat/ParametricMesh.cpp
        ThreeCompat/TubeMesh.cpp
    ThreeCompat/SceneRenderPlan.cpp
    ThreeCompat/SampleAssetDecoders.cpp)
target_link_libraries(GVMThreeCompat
    PRIVATE EASTL
    PUBLIC glm::glm EASTL_Helper nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)
if(APPLE)
    # GifImageDecoder uses Apple's libcompression for PNG inflate.  Keep the
    # dependency on the shared ThreeCompat interface so every sample that
    # embeds the decoder links consistently in both generated pipelines.
    target_link_libraries(GVMThreeCompat PUBLIC compression)
endif()
target_include_directories(GVMThreeCompat
    PUBLIC
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ThreeCompat")

    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Fixtures/ColladaAsset")

        --generated-root "${GVM_THREE_SAMPLE_GENERATED_ROOT}"

        GVMThree_SimpleRenderClass_Legacy
        GVMThree_SimpleRenderClass_Experimental
        GVMThree_FullscreenPostprocess_Legacy
        GVMThree_FullscreenPostprocess_Experimental

        "Running Phase 2 ordinary RenderClass and fullscreen postprocess four-quadrant fixtures"
    VERBATIM
    USES_TERMINAL)

        --report-json "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/three-r185-fixture-reports/phase0/summary.json"

        GVMThreeSamplesRenderSetPhase0GeneratedLint
        GVMThree_RenderSetPhase0_Legacy
        GVMThree_RenderSetPhase0_Experimental
    COMMENT
        "Running the mandatory RenderSet Phase 0 Legacy/Experimental x Metal/Vulkan gate"
    VERBATIM
    USES_TERMINAL)

gvm_add_three_sample_shard(
    NAME WebglGeometryShapes
    DSL_SOURCE
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Dsl/WebglGeometryShapes/WebglGeometryShapes.hpp"
    RENDERER_TYPE WebglGeometryShapesRenderer
    RENDERER_FACTORY makeWebglGeometryShapesRenderer
    RUNTIME_ADAPTER_HEADER WebglGeometryShapesRuntimeAdapter.hpp
    RUNTIME_ADAPTER_TYPE GVM::ThreeSamples::WebglGeometryShapesRuntimeAdapter
    HOST_SOURCES
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Fixtures/Phase1TextureCases/GifImageDecoder.cpp"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Fixtures/Phase1GeometryRenderSet/ExtrudeGeometry.cpp"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Fixtures/WebglGeometryShapes/WebglGeometryShapesRuntimeAdapter.cpp"
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Fixtures/Phase1TextureCases"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Fixtures/Phase1GeometryRenderSet"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Fixtures/WebglGeometryShapes"
    DSL_DIRS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Dsl/WebglGeometryShapes")

target_link_libraries(GVMThree_WebglGeometryShapes_LegacyApp
    PRIVATE JPEG::JPEG "-framework ImageIO" "-framework CoreGraphics" "-lcompression")
target_link_libraries(GVMThree_WebglGeometryShapes_ExperimentalApp
    PRIVATE JPEG::JPEG "-framework ImageIO" "-framework CoreGraphics" "-lcompression")
